product.name: LEGO Disney Stitch & Scrump - Building Toy for Girls & Boys, Ages 9+ - Posable Stitch Toy for Bedroom or Shelf Decor - Disney Gift for Fans - 43296
product.shortDescription: Kids can build an adorable pair of friends with the LEGO Disney Stitch & Scrump (43296) building toy for girls and boys ages 9 years old and up. This LEGO Disney building toy features a posable, brick-built Stitch figure and a smaller buildable Scrump in a plushie style, both packed with authentic details from the movies. Builders can pose Stitch in fun positions by tilting his head, adjusting his ears up and down or moving his arms and hands. Fun accessories, such as a ukulele that fits in Stitch's hands and a grass skirt that attaches around his waist, are included so fans can recreate his iconic island style. Between playtimes, kids can display both characters on a bookshelf, nightstand or desk, or pair them with other LEGO Disney building toys (sold separately) to expand their collection. Makes a great birthday gift idea for girls and boys who love Lilo & Stitch and LEGO Disney building toys. With the Build Together mode in the LEGO Builder app, friends and family can team up to build the set together, with each person creating part of it using their own device. Contains 713 pieces.
